raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / BORGHETTO SUL MESCHIO - VITTORIO VENETO NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT Borghetto Sul Meschio - Vittorio Veneto VITTORIO VENETO · TREVISO PRICE Price on request Photos (15) Floor plans (0) 1 / 15 FLOOR AREA 100 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview There are places that you inhabit. And places capable of evoking emotions every day. In Vittorio Veneto, along the banks of the Meschio River, the ancient Rizzardi-Galvani Paper Mill is reborn: a historic complex whose origins date back to 1635, now at the center of an important architectural recovery project. Thus Borghetto sul Meschio is born, a new way of living where the charm of history meets contemporary comfort, immersed in a landscape of water, nature, and silence. The project includes 20 exclusive residences divided between La Terrazza and La Torre, with areas ranging from about 70 to over 200 square meters. The different housing types are designed to meet various needs: apartments with large private gardens, bright terraces, panoramic loggias and penthouses characterized by stunning views over the village and surrounding landscape. The interiors feature generous spaces with large openings and a careful selection of materials and finishes. Natural light accompanies each space creating a continuous dialogue between architecture, greenery and landscape; each residence has one or more parking spaces covered by a distributed garden while the complex also includes storage dedicated to bicycles. An added value for those who wish to experience the area and take advantage of the pedestrian-bicycle path that runs alongside the Meschio River located just steps from the property. Borghetto sul Meschio is not just a residential project but represents the rebirth of a place destined to become a new reference point for Vittorio Veneto. Next to residences there will be spaces dedicated to hospitality and catering inserted into an environment rich in historical and environmental value. The location combines tranquility with practicality: central Vittorio Veneto, hospitals as well as access points for A27 motorway can all be reached within minutes while Conegliano and Prosecco Hills offer territories full of culture,nature,and gastronomic excellence.Borghetto sulMeschiois idealforthose seeking prestigious primary residence,a second home immersed in beauty or distinctive real estate investment within unique regeneration efforts.Here,the past isn’t forgotten—it comes back alive transforming itself intoa placewhereonecanimagine their future.
